entries.german: fordert Ulrich v. Rosenberg u. Johann v. Malovic auf, die in ihrem Kreise gesammelte königl. Steuer baldmöglichst einzuschicken. Ad m. d. i. Johanne [de Kunwald] subcamarario referente.
entries.english: He urges Ulrich von Rosenberg and Johann von Malovic to send in as soon as possible the royal tax collected in their district. By order of the lord, with Johann [de Kunwald], subchamberlain, reporting.
